# Nikola Tesla — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Nikola Tesla work in?", "electrical engineering"),
    ("What is Nikola Tesla known for?", "AC power systems"),
    ("What is lived?", "1856-1943"),
    ("What is field?", "electrical engineering"),
    ("What is known for?", "AC power systems"),
    ("What is note?", "Held ~300 patents; the Tesla coil"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
